newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Renaissance sets up new fund, asset group.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Renaissance sets up new fund, asset group.

text.p: Russian-based investment bank Renaissance Capital announced the formation of Renaissance Capital Asset Management and the launch of an offshore fund serving high net worth individual and institutional investors.
The fund will target portfolio investors seeking minimum investments of $1 million in securities of companies in Russia and other CIS countries, a statement from Renaissance said.

"We are responding to demand among our clients for sophisticated asset management products and to rapidly growing interest in Russia among worldwide investors," the statement quoted Renaissance's chief executive Boris Jordan as saying.
The asset management company will be headed by Chief Investment Officer and Acting Chief Executive Officer Fredrick Lekman, who will also be the new offshore fund's head manager.
